name: com.sobot.chat.activity.halfdialog.SobotMuItiPostMsgActivty
description: When a user opens the detailed offline-message form, Sobot's customer-service chat SDK shows this dialog. It collects the message and contact details, supports photo or video attachments, and submits the request.
disableEffect: The user will not be able to send this detailed offline support request or attach media to it.
